Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) Quarterly Sentiment Report April 8, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Sentiment for Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) institutional sentiment increased to 0.73 in 2017 Q4 . Its up 0.03, from 0.7 in 2017Q3. The ratio has increased, as 788 active investment managers started new or increased stock positions, while 1073 reduced and sold equity positions in Apple Inc. The active investment managers in our partner’s database now have: 2.98 billion shares, up from 2.97 billion shares in 2017Q3. Also, the number of active investment managers holding Apple Inc in their top 10 stock positions decreased from 957 to 948 for a decrease of 9. Sold All: 50 Reduced: 1023 Increased: 637 New Position: 151.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $854.36 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 17.36 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
The stock decreased 2.56% or $4.42 during the last trading session, reaching $168.38. About 35.01M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
